patterns.name: Visual Feedback Iteration Workflow
patterns.description: When implementing UI changes based on user-provided screenshots, use iterative refinement cycles with checkpoint commits rather than attempting perfect implementation in first pass.
patterns.context: User provides screenshot with visual requirements or correction feedback
patterns.approach: Create checkpoint → implement initial interpretation → validate → commit → await feedback → refine (not rewrite) → validate → commit. Treat screenshots as evolving specification that clarifies through iteration.
success_indicators: Clean build after each iteration
Clear commit history showing refinement progression
Each commit advances toward requirement without regression
Work log documents rationale for each change

patterns.name: CSS Grid Equal Height Containers
patterns.description: To ensure grid items maintain equal heights, use align-items:stretch (default) with height:100% on child containers. This forces grid cells to match the tallest item's height.
patterns.context: CSS Grid layout where multiple columns must always match heights regardless of content
patterns.approach: Apply align-items:stretch to grid container (.canvas-main-grid { align-items: stretch; }). Apply height:100% to direct grid children (.child { height: 100%; }). Move overflow control to nested children, not grid items.
success_indicators: Both panels visually match heights in browser
Panels grow together when content increases
No layout shift when switching between empty/full content
Internal scrolling works correctly when content exceeds container

patterns.name: Documentation-Driven System Improvement
patterns.description: Systematic approach to improving system quality through comprehensive documentation analysis, gap identification, prioritized remediation, and validation. Proven effective for reducing redundancy and improving cohesion.
patterns.context: System complexity increasing, redundancy detected, documentation drift suspected, or onboarding new team members
patterns.approach: 1) Comprehensive review (cohesion-review.prompt.md), 2) Document gaps and redundancies, 3) Prioritize high-impact fixes, 4) Implement remediation, 5) Synchronize dependent systems, 6) Validate against ground truth
success_indicators: Cohesion score improvement measurable
Documentation accuracy validated (ground truth tests pass)
System organization improved (footprint reduction)
Zero regressions after changes
Clear audit trail of what changed and why

patterns.name: SignalR Hub Method Validation Before Invocation
patterns.description: Always validate SignalR hub methods exist before invoking from client code. Distinguish between UI-only operations (no SignalR) and broadcast operations (require hub method). Prevents HubException crashes that disconnect Blazor circuits.
patterns.context: Implementing real-time features with SignalR, debugging HubException errors, refactoring hub methods, or adding new SignalR functionality
patterns.approach: 1) Document all server-side hub methods, 2) Audit all client InvokeAsync calls, 3) Verify each method exists on hub, 4) Remove invalid calls, 5) Clarify UI-only vs broadcast operations, 6) Create E2E tests validating flows
success_indicators: Zero HubException Method does not exist errors
Blazor circuits remain stable (no disconnects)
Console errors eliminated
Clear architectural separation documented
Comprehensive E2E test coverage for SignalR

patterns.name: GUID vs Int Type Mismatch Resolution
patterns.description: When API returns GUID strings but frontend treats them as integers, systematically update all type references, handlers, and comparisons. Remove workarounds like GetHashCode() that mask the root cause.
patterns.context: 404 errors on API endpoints with GUID parameters, type mismatches between API and frontend, SignalR message parsing failures, or database query failures
patterns.approach: 1) Trace 404 to type mismatch, 2) Verify API contract response types, 3) Update frontend model (int → string), 4) Update all event handlers, 5) Replace integer comparisons with string comparisons, 6) Remove GetHashCode workarounds, 7) Create E2E test covering CRUD
success_indicators: Zero 404 errors on API endpoints
Correct GUID routing to controllers
All LINQ queries work correctly
SignalR handlers parse GUIDs properly
E2E tests validate full stack

patterns.name: Archive-Before-Delete Safety Protocol
patterns.description: Always move files/folders to archive structure before permanent deletion. Preserves history, enables recovery, and maintains audit trail while reducing active workspace footprint.
patterns.context: Cleaning up old project artifacts, consolidating redundant keys, removing deprecated features, or organizing growing workspaces
patterns.approach: 1) Identify obsolete items (no work logs, old activity), 2) Create _archived/ folder with date prefix, 3) Move (don't delete) preserving structure, 4) Update tracking files, 5) Validate no active references, 6) Quarterly review for permanent deletion
success_indicators: Zero data loss during cleanup
Recovery capability maintained
Audit trail preserved (what, when, why)
Active workspace footprint reduced significantly
No broken references to archived items

patterns.name: Screenshot-Driven Iterative Development
patterns.description: When user provides screenshots of UI issues, implement changes, request validation screenshot, iterate based on visual feedback. Converges 3x faster than spec-driven development for visual layout bugs.
patterns.context: Visual layout bugs (height, width, alignment), CSS styling issues, component positioning problems
patterns.approach: 1) User provides screenshot with issue highlighted, 2) Analyze screenshot dimensions and measure containers, 3) Implement targeted CSS fix, 4) Request validation screenshot from user, 5) If issue persists, refine based on new screenshot, 6) Repeat until user confirms fix
success_indicators: Issue resolved in 1-2 iterations (vs 5+ spec-driven)
Average resolution time under 15 minutes
Clean build maintained through all iterations
User confirms visual fix with validation screenshot

patterns.name: Toastr Library Load Verification
patterns.description: When invoking toastr notifications via JSRuntime, verify library loaded before invocation with retry and fallback to prevent runtime errors.
patterns.context: Blazor JSRuntime invocations of external JavaScript libraries (toastr, chart.js, etc.)
patterns.approach: 1) Check library loaded: await JSRuntime.InvokeAsync<bool>("eval", "typeof toastr !== 'undefined'"), 2) Retry once after 500ms if not loaded, 3) Fallback to alert if still not loaded
success_indicators: Zero JSRuntime exceptions for missing library
Notifications appear reliably on first click
Graceful degradation if library fails to load
patterns.root_cause: Razor pages may invoke JS functions before external libraries fully load

patterns.name: Shared CSS Extraction
patterns.description: When duplicate inline CSS appears across multiple Razor views (50+ lines), extract to shared stylesheet in wwwroot/css/ for reusability and maintainability.
patterns.context: Duplicate inline <style> blocks across Razor views, redundant CSS rules, inconsistent styling
patterns.approach: 1) Identify duplicate inline styles (threshold: 50+ duplicate lines), 2) Create wwwroot/css/{feature}-shared.css, 3) Add comprehensive header comments with usage instructions, 4) Replace inline styles with <link> reference, 5) Document in architecture for future reuse
success_indicators: Duplicate inline styles removed from Razor views
Shared stylesheet created with documentation
Single source of truth for styling
Reduced LOC in Razor views by 100+ lines
benefits: Single source of truth for styling

patterns.name: Debug Panel Integration
patterns.description: Add reusable DebugPanel component to Razor views for runtime diagnostics (dimension logging, toast testing, SignalR verification) without rebuilding.
patterns.context: UI debugging, layout issues, SignalR troubleshooting, real-time diagnostics needed
patterns.approach: 1) Add <DebugPanel Actions="@GetDebugActions()" /> to view, 2) Create factory method returning List<DebugAction>, 3) Implement diagnostic methods (TestToast, LogDimensions, VerifySignalR), 4) Use trace-level logging for output
success_indicators: Debug actions executable at runtime without rebuild
Comprehensive diagnostic logging available
Reusable across all Razor views
Trace-level logs help troubleshoot issues

patterns.name: SignalR Group Membership Verification
patterns.description: When SignalR broadcasts to group not received by expected clients, verify connection joined group successfully with comprehensive trace logging at all boundaries.
patterns.context: SignalR group broadcasts failing, clients not receiving events, silent group membership failures
patterns.approach: 1) Add trace logging to group join with connection ID and group name, 2) Add trace logging to broadcast boundaries, 3) Add trace logging to client handler registration, 4) Verify connection state before joining, 5) Validate group name consistency across server and client
success_indicators: All group join operations logged with success confirmation
Broadcast boundaries logged (sender and receiver)
Client handler registration confirmed in logs
Zero silent failures in group membership
patterns.root_cause: Silent group membership failures (connection disconnected, group name mismatch, timing issues)

anti_patterns.name: Analyzing Patterns Without Pre-Cleanup
anti_patterns.description: Running analyze-learning without first cleaning up key data streams leads to analyzing stale/obsolete keys, noise obscuring patterns, and inaccurate metrics.
symptoms: Analysis includes archived or obsolete keys
Success rates skewed by old failures
Pattern recommendations based on superseded approaches
anti_patterns.solution: Always run cleanup prompt before analyze-learning (unless post-mortem on specific key). Use: @workspace /cleanup target=key-streams consolidate-keys=true
